info.name: Ignition Gateway REST access-control reports-info API

params.name: path
params.description: (Required) The path of the report to cancel.

items.docs: Cancel the report with the given name on the given project.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of items to return.

params.name: offset
params.description: The number of items to skip before returning results.

params.name: sortBy
params.description:
The name of a field to sort by. Use `asc(fieldName)` or `desc(fieldName)`
to specify the sort direction as ascending or descending, respectively.

params.name: search
params.description: A search string to filter items by. Terms separated by whitespace.

params.name: key_0
params.description: Filter items by field name, using format like `fieldName[op]=value` where `op` is one of: `eq` (equals), `ne` (not equals), `cn` (contains), `sw` (starts with), `ew` (ends with), `gt` (greater than), `gte` (greater than or equal), `lt` (less than), `lte` (less than or equal), `rgx` (regular expression).
